$comment: Suite run-lineage/v1 (v6.3 M2c): post-execution evidence through a result binding. Obligations are generated from the chain roots before execution and stay unverified (check.not_executed) until a result binding is given. Reads campaign records, execution bundles and computational-runs: input closure, acyclic run dependencies, unique product mapping, status propagation. Not supported: execution monitoring, scheduling, arbitrary step tracing, rebuilding an attempt model. Version 1.1.0 (release R3, stable; the default suite from R3): check-context 1.1.0; the R2 and R3 rule fixes and, for counting-chain, r-real.undescribed on generator 1.1.0 (see contracts/rules/registry.json). The 1.0.0 suite names rule versions this checker no longer runs (check.rule_not_run); reproduce 1.0.0 results with release R1.
